title: Pay a differing endpoint mass row once at final leaves
statement: Raw branch preparations have mass rows m and m_f rather than a common all-ones row. Isolating (m-m_f)C_h before the native true-prefix/fitted-CP-suffix telescope gives TV<=b E_true[L]+(K_core/2)max_j e_m,j. Actual final outcome rows already include this mismatch and replace, rather than add to, the mass debit.
